safety_lead_time.comparison_action: INCREASE: Recommended safety lead time is significantly higher than SAP

narrative: Material PL2__M84B015C exhibits lumpy demand characteristics with a coefficient of variation of 1.56. The analysis of 132 working days shows a mean daily demand of 755.01 units with 39.4% of days having non-zero demand. Lead time analysis based on 51 observations shows moderate variability (CV=0.53) with mean of 2.22 days. The recommended safety stock of 3243 units (equivalent to 4.30 days of coverage) is 38.6% higher than the current SAP setting of 2339 units. This adjustment is necessary to achieve the target service level of 95% given the observed demand and lead time variability. The EOQ-based order quantity of 8099 units represents 11 days of supply and balances ordering costs against holding costs.
warnings: Optimised policy has higher total cost than SAP policy ($825.46 increase). This is due to higher safety stock requirements.
2 outliers detected in demand data and winsorized

research_insights.selection_rationale: Material exhibits lumpy demand with moderate lead time. Classic EOQ is appropriate given the demand characteristics and service level requirements.
